description: This file defines the StorageComparerInterface interface in the Drupal core configuration system, specifying methods for comparing and managing configuration storage objects.

classes.name: StorageComparerInterface
classes.description: Interface for comparison of configuration storage objects in Drupal.

methods.name: getSourceStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the source storage object used for reading configuration.

methods.name: getTargetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the target storage object used for writing configuration.

methods.name: writeMode
methods.description: Sets the comparer to write mode, optimizing caching strategies.

methods.name: getEmptyChangelist
methods.description: Returns an empty list of configuration changes.

methods.name: getChangelist
methods.description: Gets a list of configuration changes to import, optionally filtered by operation and collection.

methods.name: createChangelist
methods.description: Calculates differences between source and target configurations.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Recalculates differences, resetting the comparer state.

methods.name: hasChanges
methods.description: Checks if there are any configuration changes to process.

methods.name: validateSiteUuid
methods.description: Validates that the site UUIDs in source and target match.

methods.name: moveRenameToUpdate
methods.description: Converts a rename operation into an update.

methods.name: extractRenameNames
methods.description: Extracts old and new configuration names from a rename operation.

methods.name: getAllCollectionNames
methods.description: Retrieves all existing configuration collection names.
